sequence-lights.title: Light Sequence
sequence-lights.description: Remember the order in which the cells light up.
instructions: Watch the cells light up, one after another.
When you see “Your turn”, tap them in the same order.
Get it right and the sequence grows; miss and it shrinks.

arrows.title: Arrows
arrows.description: Focus only on the middle arrow, even when the others try to distract you.
instructions: You will see a row of five arrows.
Tell which way the middle arrow points, using the buttons or your arrow keys.
Ignore the side arrows: sometimes they point the other way.

same-different.title: Same or Different?
same-different.description: Decide as fast as you can whether each symbol matches the previous one.
instructions: First you will see a symbol: remember it.
Then another appears: answer “Yes” if it matches the previous one or “No” if it is different.
Each symbol is compared with the one right before it. Streaks of correct answers multiply your points.
same-different.question: Does it match the previous one?
